title: apiAccount

email.description: The email address of the user.

devices.description: The devices which belong to the user's account.

customId.description: The custom id in the user's account.

verifyTime.description: The UNIX time (for gRPC clients) or ISO string (for REST clients) when the user's email was verified.

disableTime.description: The UNIX time (for gRPC clients) or ISO string (for REST clients) when the user's account was disabled/banned.

description: A user with additional account details. Always the current user.
